# Fixture provenance

`tenhou-ranked.json` is the real Tenhou game fixture from Equim-chan/mjai-reviewer,
`convlog/tests/testdata/ranked_game.json`, commit
`2dc5ec5c8b28517cfb45f57eb21536d9a8f67aa9` (Apache-2.0).
Game ref: `2019050417gm-0029-0000-4f2a8622`. Names are upstream anonymized.
`example.mjai.jsonl` is its unmodified convlog conversion, generated by
`scripts/prepare-example.py`. It is a real Tenhou fixture, **not a successful Mahjong Soul link download**.

Synthetic states and protocol responses in unit tests are explicitly test doubles,
never served by production adapters or presented as trained AI results.
